reasoning: Stephen Lynch is the long-time incumbent in MA-08 and, to my knowledge, is seeking reelection in 2026. He has comfortably beaten progressive primary challengers before, including Brianna Wu by roughly 70-23 in 2018. The main risks are anti-incumbent energy among Democratic primary voters in 2026, possible well-funded progressive challengers given his relatively moderate record, and his age (about 71), which raises some chance of retirement or health issues before the September 1 primary.
